title: Signed line PowerFlat
statement: If P is locally free of rank one on a covering of the final object of its ringed site, then every signed power P^[d], d∈Z [def-pur-signed-line-pullback-normalization-data], is flat in the sense of IsFlatOnSite [def-pc-flat-sheaf-modules], including the degree-zero unit and the internal duals of positive powers.

source.place: Tags 03D2, 03D3, 03EL and 0FNY; for derived localization use derived.tex Tags 06YU, 07A4 and 015F. Specialization of the Powers and duals paragraph of the current blueprint.

proof.text: On each rank-one chart, tensor restriction and the unit tensor comparison identify every positive power with the coefficient ring. The evaluation-inverse-pair theorem identifies each negative power with the corresponding dual free line. Tensoring with the coefficient unit is exact; flatness is local on the covering family, giving every signed power.

proof_origin.place: Powers and duals, including unit, positive tensor recursion, evaluation, and unbounded derived action. The component proof is given below and in the attached Lean module.
